notes.title: v1.56 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would seemingly hard-lock the game during the level 5 pool leisure activity
[*] Fixed some dresser memories being available before they are unlocked
[/list]

notes.title: v1.55 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The Crater will now be available and accessible from the town after having cleared the game
[*] Fixed an issue causing the level 5 Crater activity to be available earlier than intended
[*] Polished and redesigned visually the level selection screen of the memory system
[*] Updated Crater activity memory thumbnails to also include the duck events
[*] Added thumbnails to the epilogue memories that were missing them
[*] Added CG viewer functionality to the Nube gift social event memory
[*] CG Viewer button will no longer appear when the selected memory doesn't have its CG viewer function implemented
[*] Fixed PUB persistent NPC event not being available when replaying the PUB work activity through the memory system
[*] Fixed an issue during the level 5 PUB persistent NPC event that caused Hana's maid bikini to not appear when the back sprite was in use when seeing the NPC event after the cleaning event
[*] When viewing a previous unseen level of the level 5 PUB persistent NPC, Hana will now temporarily revert to the uniform that is intended for that event for the duration of the event
[*] World sprites will now adjust their brightness based on the current time
[*] Fixed the level 1 standing split event memory being broken after v1.5
[*] Fixed an epilogue memory removing the 2000 silver once again when replaying it
[*] Fixed Hana's hat remaining on her sprite after replaying the last epilogue memory
[*] Changed the warmth social event from a level 3 event into now being a level 5 event
[/list]

notes.title: v.1.51 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing locker interactions to break when repeating activities after having cleared the game
[*] Fixed some issues causing soft locks during the level 6 lifeguard activity when repeating the activity after having cleared the game
[*] Fixed issues with the level 2 lake event that would occasionally break the event
[*] Added some missing visual effects for Hana's sprite and CGs during the stargazer events
[*] Added some missing visual effects for Hana's sprite and CGs during the duck events, and fixed some minor clipping issues with her clothing during certain parts of the CG
[*] Fixed an issue causing the duck events to not play when viewing an activity memory
[*] Minor adjustment to make world sprites brighter
[/list]

notes.title: v1.06
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added a log function to view previous pieces of dialogue from the current conversation (Press ctrl)
[*] Fixed a bug which would occasionally lead to a hard-lock during the level 3 level up event
[*] Fixed a rare instance during the prologue day in which working at the PUB would be started before acquiring the maid outfit
[*] Fixed a rare instance during the first level up event in which the wrong dialogue would play after clearing the bathhouse for the first time, leading to the routine for the event breaking and causing a soft-lock
[*] Fixed an issue causing a soft-lock during the level 1 lifeguard activity
[*] Added a fix for a very rare instance where the first level up event would not start properly, and would lead to a soft-locked save file
[*] Fixed an issue sometimes causing door dialogue from the previous area to play after having entered a new area
[*] Changed the calculation for money earned during the level 5 level up event. The updated calculation results in having to earn less money during level 6 in order to reach the amount needed to start the epilogue
[/list]
